Capability Capsules.risk_response: No admission may change a running plan or widen permissions. A failure keeps the human activation path

Architecture.name: Architecture
Architecture.work_details: Component rollup; recalculate from child rows.
Architecture.risk_response: Missing output, access or evidence blocks the affected claim; narrow scope or move the gate, never bypass required checks.

Architecture.name: Fold interfaces into the coding package
Architecture.expected_result: RSI, Router and benchmark interfaces merged into coding handoff.
Architecture.work_details: Share interface decisions with CC design; count human effort once on linked CC task.
Architecture.metric: Blocking interfaces resolved or deferred; versioned handoff.
Architecture.resources: CC package; RSI/Router inputs; sidecar/test interface handoff.
Architecture.risk_response: Missing output, access or evidence blocks the affected claim; narrow scope or move the gate, never bypass required checks.

Architecture.name: Record RSI and Router seams as non-blocking
Architecture.expected_result: Future-seam table in the core build page. No core dependency on RSI or the Router
Architecture.work_details: Fold supplied Model Router and RSI designs into the existing architecture. Record producer, consumer, typed payload, compatibility, failure route and the boundary between independently buildable RSI and the live core.
Architecture.metric: Each seam names what is kept now and what later work plugs in
Architecture.resources: Received RSI and Router designs; core build page
Architecture.risk_response: No human effort on either before the core gate

Architecture.name: Integrate returned benchmark interface
Architecture.expected_result: Benchmark runner design with case, campaign, hardware inventory, run record, outcome mapping and evaluation-profile entry points
Architecture.work_details: Review the materials returned by the Benchmark/code-verification owner. Fold compatible interfaces into the Dockerized sidecar runner and test-interface design, recording gaps and expected report/artifact fields.
Architecture.metric: Every interface the October 14 benchmark requirements need is named with fields, or listed as an open item for the Benchmark owner
Architecture.resources: Benchmark requirements (Oct 14); sidecar and test-runner designs
Architecture.risk_response: Open items: M1 acceptance scope, model pin, 16 GB host. They stay with the Benchmark owner

Architecture.name: Finalize benchmark runner handoff
Architecture.expected_result: Benchmark runner page agreed with the Benchmark owner
Architecture.work_details: Resolve remaining interface gaps and finalize invocation, case input, result/evidence output and error behavior with the Benchmark owner. Reuse the existing design. This is separate development tooling, not a product runtime dependency.
Architecture.metric: Open items answered or recorded with an owner role
Architecture.resources: Benchmark runner design
Architecture.risk_response: The runner is never a product dependency

Architecture.name: Close one-shot readiness blockers and sync the compact package
Architecture.expected_result: Design package a coding agent can build from without inventing shared names or fields
Architecture.metric: Readiness blockers B1 to B14 closed or recorded. Validator passes. Adversarial review findings fixed. Compact package synced
Architecture.resources: One-shot readiness plan; PRD; design package
Architecture.risk_response: A PRD gap found here stays open and blocks only the affected CC

Architecture.name: Package ready for coding
Architecture.expected_result: Reduced design and handoff ready for coding start.
Architecture.work_details: Confirm CC package, module interfaces, gates and deferred items.
Architecture.metric: Version and blockers indexed.
Architecture.resources: CC package; interface decisions; gate profile; separate sidecar tooling.
Architecture.risk_response: Missing product interface blocks only dependent scope; sidecar is not a product dependency.

Architecture.name: Implementation feedback and architecture refinement
Architecture.expected_result: Post-code, verifier and benchmark findings reviewed; conditional architecture freeze.
Architecture.work_details: Design the next cycle while investigating M1. Post-code investigation 1.2.1, verifier assignments 1.2.3 and benchmark investigation 1.2.4 cover the intervening workdays; Architecture consumes their findings once. Product authorship remains with the PRD owner.
Architecture.metric: Findings linked; PRD and blockers reviewed before freeze.
Architecture.resources: CC reviews; verifier results; sidecar/test results; supplied PRD; gate decisions.
Architecture.risk_response: Missing output, access or evidence blocks the affected claim; narrow scope or move the gate, never bypass required checks.

Architecture.name: Launch coding and outline next-cycle inputs
Architecture.expected_result: Coding handoff confirmed and next-cycle inputs listed.
Architecture.work_details: Confirm versioned package; list PRD, resource and interface inputs.
Architecture.metric: Handoff and input owners recorded.
Architecture.resources: Coding package; PRD and interface inputs.
Architecture.risk_response: Missing output, access or evidence blocks the affected claim; narrow scope or move the gate, never bypass required checks.

Architecture.name: Classify design defects from generated code
Architecture.expected_result: List separating design defects from implementation defects
Architecture.metric: Each item links to a contract and an observed output. Design defects get a fix owner
Architecture.resources: One-shot code; 1.2.1 first-day findings
Architecture.risk_response: Oct 19 belongs to CC investigation. If the output is late, shift with 1.2.1

Architecture.name: Revise M2 architecture draft and interface DAG
Architecture.expected_result: M2 draft for Generalist, generation, admission and better planning, aligned with the M2 PRD draft
Architecture.work_details: Reuse existing contracts and agent drafts while consuming post-code and verifier findings. Product scope comes from the PRD owner; unresolved clauses remain draft.
Architecture.metric: One acyclic interface DAG with ports, check duties, resource needs and open issues
Architecture.resources: M2 PRD draft (5.2.3); post-code findings; module interfaces
Architecture.risk_response: Oct 21 to 23 is left free for verifier assignments. A missing or conflicting PRD section keeps that part of the draft open

Architecture.name: Revise draft from verifier and benchmark results
Architecture.expected_result: M2 draft updated with M1 verification and benchmark findings
Architecture.metric: Each finding from 1.2.3 and the midweek benchmark review has a design disposition
Architecture.resources: Verifier results; benchmark midweek review (6.2.6)
Architecture.risk_response: Partial benchmark data is enough. Record what is missing

Architecture.name: Draft and release architecture feedback form
Architecture.expected_result: Architecture feedback form released with clear interface and evidence questions.
Architecture.work_details: Prepare and release the form for team responses on PRD alignment, blocking interfaces, evidence and capacity.
Architecture.metric: Form released; response owners and due point recorded.
Architecture.resources: Current architecture draft; PRD/interface questions; team response channel.
Architecture.risk_response: No response is treated as approval; unresolved interfaces remain blockers.

Architecture.name: Index final M1 evidence
Architecture.expected_result: Final M1 code, verifier and benchmark evidence indexed.
Architecture.work_details: Link exact code, plan, verifier, benchmark and gate records; label unavailable evidence.
Architecture.metric: Index resolves exact revisions, runs and outcomes.
Architecture.resources: CC closeout; verifier assignments; benchmark outputs; gate decisions.
Architecture.risk_response: Missing evidence keeps architecture freeze conditional.

Architecture.name: Hold M2 architecture review session and revise the package
Architecture.expected_result: Team responses, M1 evidence and PRD alignment reviewed for the conditional freeze.
Architecture.work_details: Resolve blocking interface and capacity findings from the feedback form; record disagreement or missing response explicitly.
Architecture.metric: Every blocking item has disposition and owner role; PRD is aligned or freeze remains open.
Architecture.resources: Architecture feedback form; team responses; PRD 5.2; M1 evidence 1.3 and 6.2; shared CC/benchmark results.
Architecture.risk_response: No missing response is treated as approval; required PRD/evidence alignment blocks freeze.

Architecture.name: Conditional M2 architecture freeze

Architecture.work_details: Freeze only after team responses, PRD alignment, M1 evidence, resources and blockers are reviewed.
Architecture.metric: PRD aligned; evidence and interfaces reviewed; conditions recorded.
Architecture.resources: Reviewed responses; supplied PRD; M1 evidence; architecture disposition; capacity/access.
Architecture.risk_response: Condition: M2 PRD published (5.2.7) and every blocking item dispositioned. Otherwise the freeze moves and 1.4.1 moves with it

Architecture.name: Build optional design and PRD integrity report skill

Architecture.work_details: Use pinned sources and seeded expectations; human review owns decisions. Optional shared-capacity tooling, not product dependency.
Architecture.metric: Three cases yield attributable reports; no automatic compliance claim.
Architecture.resources: Existing handoff skill; PRD/design; seeded expectations; agent runtime.
Architecture.risk_response: Optional; move if capacity is consumed. It does not block core product or freeze.

Architecture.resources: November CC outputs; aligned PRD; interface and capacity inputs.
Architecture.risk_response: Missing output, access or evidence blocks the affected claim; narrow scope or move the gate, never bypass required checks.

Architecture.resources: M2 freeze; M3 PRD scope (5.3.2)
